data.narrative:
Persona AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Nic Radford and Jerry Pratt that has raised $25M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 10 private robotics and manufacturing companies plus one public comparable (277810.KQ), though peer-based valuation constraints limit direct application of median benchmarking.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable framework here. Using the $25M total raised as a proxy for current valuation, a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $62M. The Peer-Median approach is not sufficiently reliable given that the available robotics and manufacturing peer set lacks three or more comparable datapoints at the same stage or adjacent stage with similar valuation tier characteristics; relying on a broad sector median would introduce unwarranted noise.

The triangulation, anchored to the single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $53M (low) to $72M (median $62M). The range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression base case. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific market segment and the lack of direct peer validation. Additional datapoints from later-stage robotics financings or closer-stage comps would strengthen conviction in this range.
